name: Neo-brutalism
when: A loud, confident ad or announcement for a young brand: a drop, a sale, a launch, a free plan. Works for products, apps and offers that want to stop the scroll.
look: Chunky flat blocks in bright colours with thick black borders and hard offset shadows, oversized type, stickers and a marquee strip
pace: Snappy: blocks slam in on the beat, a new element every half second, a held offer card
